newsitem.title: USA: Kaneb Services board approves share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Kaneb Services board approves share buyback.

text.p: Kaneb Services Inc said on Friday its board of directors had authorized the repurchase of up to 10 percent of its oustanding common stock on the open market.
Purchases would be funded internally and held in the company's treasury, Kaneb said in a statement. It had 33.6 million common shares outstanding, the company said.

"The authorization to repurchase our stock affirms the Board's confidence in the long-term prospects of the company and our belief that the repurchase of the company's stock at current price levels is an attractive use of corporate assets," Kaneb Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer John Barnes said in a statement.
Kaneb, which provides specialized industrial services, said it would buy back shares when it deemed appropriate.
